whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Afraa,

I noticed your restaurant has exceptional 4.3★ reviews with over 1,500 happy diners in Chajju Bagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and digital menu page for quick table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature menu highlights, aur Google review integration hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/afraa

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Afraa, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Afraa) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your dining experience in City Centre Mall, Chajju Bagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback. Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
